components.css: .ds-row { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto 18px; gap: 24px; align-items: baseline; width: 100%; padding: 18px 0; border: 0; background: none; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 1.0625rem; color: #CBD5E1; } .ds-row::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0 -14px; border-radius: 6px; background: #162033; opacity: 0; transition: opacity .2s; z-index: -1; } .ds-row:hover::before { opacity: 1; } .ds-row-main { display: grid; gap: 3px; } .ds-row-title { color: #F8FAFC; font-weight: 500; } .ds-row-at { color: #CBD5E1; font-weight: 400; } .ds-row-desc { color: #94A3B8; font-size: .9375rem; } .ds-row-side { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: .75rem; color: #94A3B8; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-row-arrow { align-self: center; color: #334155; transition: transform .2s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1), color .2s; } .ds-row:hover .ds-row-arrow, .ds-row:focus-visible .ds-row-arrow { color: #7DD3FC; transform: translate(2px,-2px); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7DD3FC; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The site reads like a dark cartographic plate: a deep slate field, faint contour lines and coordinate grids, and one highlighted route in pale sky blue. Everything that isn't the work recedes. Type and hairlines carry the structure, and the map, real or schematic, is the only place the page allows itself ornament.

Density is low and editorial. A large name, one headline, short paragraphs, then single-line lists separated by hairlines, each opening a short popup. There are no cards, no tags, and no decorative imagery. Visuals appear only where the subject is spatial: the hero's contour plate, the interactive map, and the algorithm canvas.
keyCharacteristics: One dark slate field with tonal (not shadowed) layering.
A single accent, Route Blue, reserved for map signals and interaction states.
Geist for everything readable; IBM Plex Mono only for dates and metadata.
Hairline dividers and generous vertical space instead of containers.
Cartographic motifs (contours, grids, dashed extents) only on genuine map or coordinate surfaces.

rules.name: The One Route Rule
rules.body: Route Blue marks the thing being looked at or acted on: a selected place, a focused control, a matched result. If it appears where nothing is selected or interactive, remove it.

rules.name: The No Gray-on-Color Rule
rules.body: Text sits only on slate neutrals. Never place Survey Gray or any text on a Route Blue fill.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Metadata Rule
rules.body: IBM Plex Mono is only for dates, numbers, and technical metadata. Headings, labels on controls, and prose are always Geist.

rules.name: The 11px Floor Rule
rules.body: No functional or readable text below 11px, including map labels and attribution.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the page itself casts a shadow. If something needs to stand out, give it a tonal step or a hairline, not elevation.

dos: Do keep every section to a title and a list or a short paragraph block.
Do reserve Route Blue for selection, focus, hover, and map signals (≤ a few small marks per screen).
Do use mono only for dates and numbers, at 0.75rem or larger.
Do separate content with hairlines and vertical space.
Do label any schematic or illustrative visual as such.
donts: Don't add cards, pill tags, badges, or icon tiles to lists.
Don't add shadows to anything except the popup.
Don't add grid or contour backgrounds to surfaces that aren't maps or coordinate canvases.
Don't introduce a second accent color or gradients.
